questions.question: Which specimen or diagnostic finding belongs in a reference record for Entamoeba histolytica complex?
options: Asymmetrical pinworm eggs on a perianal adhesive-tape specimen.
Microfilariae in a peripheral blood film.
Malaria rings inside erythrocytes in a thin blood film.
Cysts or trophozoites in stool; tissue or aspirate findings belong to a distinct specimen category.
questions.explanation: Cysts or trophozoites in stool; tissue or aspirate findings belong to a distinct specimen category. Permanent stained smears near 1000× show nuclear features; iodine aids cyst assessment.
